sd_structure.note: In SD Lab terms. 'flows' move things between stocks (or to outside); 'driven_inflows' are information links: outside -> `into` at k x level of `driver` per second (nothing leaves the driver). A stock with several drivers has one linear inflow: external + sum of k x level of each driver (inflow_equations). k_nominal = fan-out (or probability) / the driver's mean latency or job time (Little's law); k_realised = what the run gives, which is lower for drivers that queue (their in-flight includes requests waiting for a slot).
